assets.name: items
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game item atlas for an original ink-drawn gothic wilderness survival browser game, with the hand-drawn aesthetic of Don't Starve. Thick uneven charcoal-black outlines, angular asymmetric silhouettes, flat muted olive ochre brown slate colors, very sparse hatching. Not pixel art, not 3D, no glossy highlights. Genuine transparent background. A landscape 1536x1024 sheet with exactly FIVE columns and FOUR rows of distinct isolated objects, each object comfortably inside its equal 307x256 cell with at least 40px clear transparent margin from all cell edges. Icons upright, complete, centered in cell. NO text, labels, numbers, cell borders, backdrop, cast shadow, frame, UI or humans. Keep shapes simple readable at 32px in-game. Row-by-row left to right objects: Row1 a bundle of chopped wood logs, rough iron ore chunk, pale turnip with leaves, tied golden wheat sheaf, tiny cloth pouch of turnip seeds with an unlettered turnip pictogram. Row2 wheat seed pouch with an unlettered wheat pictogram, wooden bowl of turnip soup, rustic loaf of bread, stack of rough gold coins, three red woodland berries on a twig. Row3 pale moon herb sprig, wrapped trail ration parcel, dark bowl of moon-herb stew, tuft of harvested dry grass, a single pine cone. Row4 burning handheld twig torch, small plate of roasted berries, crude wooden sword, iron sword, round wooden shield.

assets.name: tools
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent game tool sprite atlas, original Don't Starve inspired hand-drawn gothic wilderness survival aesthetic, irregular thick black ink outlines and flat muted colors with minimal hatch marks. Exactly FOUR columns and THREE rows on landscape1536x1024. All12 items isolated, whole, upright diagonally only very slightly, center each cell with 50px empty margin. Each row shows 4 tools in order: HOE, WATERING CAN, AXE, PICKAXE. Row1 primitive wood-and-gray-stone tools and worn gray watering can. Row2 refined wooden handles, dull iron heads and iron watering can. Row3 stronger dark wood handles, brass bindings, pale refined steel heads and brass-banded steel watering can. Each level has a clearly different silhouette and larger sturdier head, not only recoloring. Handles long enough to grip, no hands. Strong simple contour and detailed grip but not busy. No labels, borders, UI, letters, other objects, shadows, people, ground, not pixel art, not3D. True transparent alpha background. Design for32px inventory icons and30px character-held tools.

assets.name: equipment
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original transparent game equipment and accessory sprite atlas in Don't Starve hand-drawn gothic survival aesthetic. Thick irregular charcoal ink contours, flat muted ochre russet gray iron colors, minimal hatching, angular asymmetric paper-cutout silhouettes. Landscape1536x1024 exactly FOUR columns THREE rows. Each cell384x341 holds ONE complete isolated object centered with at least55px transparent margins, generous separation. Row1: simple gray iron chest armor vest without person; rustic recurved hunter bow with visible string; heavy sledgehammer long wooden handle stone-metal head; bulky iron chest cuirass without person. Row2: small single olive leaf accessory; short rusty red neck scarf with loose tail; ochre cloth hair ribbon tied in bow; small dull gold five-point star brooch. Row3: crude wooden sword; iron sword with simple crossguard; round wooden buckler; sturdy leather quiver with three arrows. Inventory cutouts only, no character or hands, no text labels numbers borders background ground shadows. Not pixel art, not3D, no polished metallic rendering. Genuine transparent background.
